low.title: Full-Day Alba Iulia History Route (Low Budget)
low.summary: A full-day walk through Alba Iulia’s historic layers — Roman, medieval, and modern — with affordable local food stops.

schedule.title: Alba Carolina Fortress Gate I Start
schedule.description: Begin at the iconic Baroque gate and learn how the star-shaped Vauban fortress was built.

schedule.title: Route of the Three Fortifications
schedule.description: Glass-covered archaeological zones showing Roman castrum remains, medieval walls and Vauban structures.

schedule.title: Principia Roman Military Headquarters
schedule.description: See the reconstructed sections of the Roman headquarters and imagine daily legion life.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Affordable traditional dishes like soups, bean stew or simple Romanian mains.

schedule.title: Union Museum (Exterior & Courtyard)
schedule.description: A look at the architecture and short explanations of Alba Iulia’s role in Romanian unification.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral Grounds
schedule.description: Walk through the court where Romania’s first kings were crowned after the Great Union of 1918.

schedule.title: Obelisk of Horea, Cloșca and Crișan
schedule.description: Learn about the 1784 uprising and the historic figures represented by the monument.

schedule.title: Fortress Walls Walk
schedule.description: Circle a portion of the star-shaped bastions and bastion gates on foot.

schedule.title: Citadel Sunset
schedule.description: End your day with panoramic sunset views over old bastions and rooftops.

medium.title: Full-Day Alba Iulia Historical Walk + Local Cuisine
medium.summary: A rich dive into the city’s Roman, medieval and modern heritage with comfortable local dining.

schedule.title: Gate III & Vauban Defense System
schedule.description: Start with the grand Baroque gate and learn about fortress defense strategies.

schedule.title: Principia Roman Museum
schedule.description: Walk over the glass floor and see reconstructed rooms with Roman artifacts.

schedule.title: National Museum of the Union
schedule.description: Explore the key exhibits related to Roman Dacia, the Middle Ages and the Great Union of 1918.

schedule.title: Local Romanian Lunch
schedule.description: Comfortable mid-range traditional dishes inside the citadel.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral
schedule.description: A major symbol of modern Romanian history — learn about its architecture and royal coronation events.

schedule.title: Medieval Cathedral of St. Michael (Exterior Walk)
schedule.description: See one of Romania’s oldest and most important medieval churches from the outside.

schedule.title: Route of the Three Fortifications Highlights
schedule.description: Compare Roman, medieval and Vauban-era walls in one continuous historical path.

schedule.title: Bastion Evening Walk
schedule.description: Explore the fortress walls in soft evening light.

high.title: Premium Full-Day Historical Experience in Alba Iulia
high.summary: A curated exploration of the citadel’s Roman, medieval and modern past, paired with premium dining.

schedule.title: Gate III Baroque Sculptures
schedule.description: Detailed explanation of the symbolic statues and decorative reliefs of the gate.

schedule.title: Principia Roman HQ (Curated Visit)
schedule.description: Spend extra time examining the Roman ruins and reconstructed headquarters.

schedule.title: National Museum of the Union (Premium Highlights)
schedule.description: Focused visit on the most important artifacts and historical documents.

schedule.title: Premium Romanian Lunch
schedule.description: Taste elevated versions of regional dishes in a historic setting.

schedule.title: St. Michael's Cathedral (History Walk)
schedule.description: Learn about Transylvanian medieval architecture and bishops buried here.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral & Royal Ensemble
schedule.description: Understand its symbolism in the formation of modern Romania.

schedule.title: Vauban Bastions Elite Walk
schedule.description: Walk along the bastions and learn about the star fort’s geometry and defensive purpose.

schedule.title: Citadel Evening Viewpoints
schedule.description: Enjoy elevated views of the fortress as the lights come on.

comfortable.title: Luxury Historical Journey Through Alba Iulia
comfortable.summary: A polished, comfortable full-day history tour with premium pacing and fine dining.

schedule.title: VIP Gate Entrance
schedule.description: Enter through the fortress's most ornate Baroque gate and begin your story-rich day.

schedule.title: Guided-Style Museum of the Union Visit
schedule.description: Walk through the museum slowly, focusing on Roman and medieval heritage.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral & Royal Symbols
schedule.description: A relaxed walk around the cathedral, learning about Romania’s royal coronations.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Romanian Lunch
schedule.description: High-quality, elegant Romanian cuisine inside the citadel walls.

schedule.title: St. Michael's Cathedral (Calm Exterior Session)
schedule.description: Appreciate its medieval architecture and long, layered history.

schedule.title: Principia & Roman Traces
schedule.description: Visit the Roman ruins and learn how the fortress evolved across centuries.

schedule.title: Premium Bastion Walk
schedule.description: Explore a quieter section of the walls with scenic city views.

schedule.title: Historic Sunset Finale
schedule.description: Golden light over towers, walls and monuments — a perfect ending.
